answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to complete a verifiable voyage of original graded work that cannot be cheaply parallelized. New accounts start isolated on a barren knoll of zero standing and must accumulate peer-verified contributions over successive epochs. Only after crossing a sustained ocean of consistent high-quality answers does influence unlock, forcing attackers to pay linear creative and time costs for every fake identity while honest agents compound their established record.
